chapterInfo.content:
13
Wɔsɛe wɔ Nyankopɔn abufuo mu
1Efraim rekasa a, ɛyɛ hu;
ɔmaa ne ho so Israel mu,
ɛnna Baal nti ɔdii so, na ɔwui.
2 # Yes 44.12 Na afei wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne,
na wɔde wɔn dwetɛ yɛ guo ahoni
ne wɔn nhunumu ano adwinhoni;
ɛyɛ adwumfoɔ adwuma ara nko; wɔka no wɔ wɔn ho sɛ,
nnipa a wɔbɔ afɔdeɛ no ma wɔmfe anantwie mma ano.
3 # Hos 6.4; Dwom 1.4 Saa nti wɔbɛyɛ sɛ anɔpa mununkum
ne obosuo a ɛtua nhema korɔ,
sɛ ntɛtɛ a ahum hwim firi ayuporebea
ne wisie a ɛtu fa mpomma mu korɔ no.
4 # Eks 20.2-3 Nso mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn
de firi Misraim asase so,
na wonnim Onyankopɔn biara sɛ me nko,
na ɔgyefoɔ biara nni m’akyi.
5 # Hos 9.10 Me na mehunuu wo ɛserɛ no soɔ,
sukɔm asase no so.
6 # Deut 32.15 Ɛberɛ a wɔnyaa adidibea pa no, wɔmee,
wɔmee na wɔn akoma maa ne ho so,
enti wɔn werɛ firii me.
7 # Hos 5.14 Saa nti, meyɛɛ wɔn sɛ gyata,
metɛɛ ɔkwan mu sɛ ɔsebɔ.
8Mɛto mahyɛ wɔn so sɛ sisire a wɔafa ne mma,
na matete wɔn koko a wɔn akoma da mu no,
na mawe wɔn hɔ sɛ gyatabereɛ;
wiram mmoa bɛsunsuane wɔn mu.
9 # Yer 2.17 Meyɛ wo boafoɔ deɛ,
nanso wɔrebɛsɛe wo, O Israel!
10 # 1 Sa 8.5 Ɛhefa na afei wo hene no wɔ, na ɔnnye wo wo nkuro nyinaa mu,
ne w’atemmufoɔ
a wokaa sɛ:
Ma me ɔhene ne mmapɔmma no?
11Memaa wo ɔhene m’abufuo mu,
na meyii no hɔ m’anibereɛ mu.
12Wɔakyekyere Efraim amumuyɛ,
wɔde ne bɔne asie.
13 # Mika 4.10; Yes 37.3 Ɔwofoɔ awoɔ bɛka no;
ɔno deɛ, ɔyɛ ɔba a ɔnni nyansa,
sɛ ɛduru ne berɛ so a, ɔmmmɛgyina
deɛ mma fa mu siane hɔ.
14 # 1 Ko 15.54-55; 2 Ti 1.10; Adi 20.14; 21.4 Mɛgye wɔn mafiri Asamando nsam anaa?
Mɛgye wɔn owuo mu anaa?
Owuo, ɛhe na wo nwowɔeɛ wɔ?
Asamando, ɛhe na wo sɛeɛ wɔ?
Ahonu ahunta afiri m’ani so.
15 # Gye 49.22; Hos 4.19 Na ɔbɛso aba ne nuanom mu.
Apueeɛ ahum bɛtu,
AWURADE mframa firi ɛserɛ so bɛbɔ,
na n’asubura mu awe,
na ne nsuo aniwa to atwa;
na ɔbɛfom adekoradan mu
afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa.
16Samaria tiri ato,
sɛ wate ne Nyankopɔn anim atua;
afena ano na wɔbɛtotɔ;
wɔbɛte wɔn nkokoaa abobɔ hɔ,
na wɔapaepae wɔn anyinsɛnfoɔ mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
